verdict.line: You win the early levels and every Realm of Death you time correctly; he wins any fight where you let his resistances stay stacked.

brief.thesis: K'Sante is a resistance-stacking tank whose passive proc scales off his own bonus armor and magic resist, so flat AP does very little into him — you beat him with percent-max-health magic damage and magic penetration, never with burst. The flip side is that your R (Realm of Death) steals a percentage of his stats, so ulting him doesn't just remove the enemy frontline for seven seconds, it lets you wear his tankiness while you do it. That stat theft, not the lane, is the real win condition in this matchup.

theirWindow.what: Path Maker eats an enormous chunk of your Q (Obliterate) and blocks your E (Death's Grasp) pull outright. Do not commit a cooldown into a held W — you get nothing back and he gets a free reset.

yourWindow.when: W spent, or he is mid-Q animation
yourWindow.what: This is when Q actually lands for full value and E can drag him where you want him. Everything you want from a trade happens in the few seconds after Path Maker goes down.

playing.title: Bait Path Maker first
playing.detail: Throw Q after he commits W, or during his Q cast animation. A Q into a held Path Maker is a wasted cooldown and a free trade for him.

playing.title: Reset after his mark procs
playing.detail: His passive proc is where his damage actually comes from. Once it lands, disengage rather than standing in follow-up autos.

playing.title: Ult him in All Out, not before
playing.detail: All Out sheds a percentage of his bonus resistances. Ulting him while it's active is when your magic damage finally bites; ulting a full-resist K'Sante means beating on a wall for seven seconds.

playing.title: Use R to delete the frontline
playing.detail: In a teamfight, removing him for seven seconds while wearing his stats is often worth more than the kill. Their team fights 4v5 and you are briefly the tank.

playing.title: Don't E into his dash
playing.detail: Death's Grasp gets blocked during Path Maker's dash. Hold it until he's committed and grounded.

playing.title: Shove and take the 6 all-in
playing.detail: You're favoured levels 1-3, he takes 4-5, and you get it back at 6 with a shoved wave. Set that wave up before you hit level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Matchup logic here is stable across patches. Item names and rune numbers drift — sanity-check the exact list against the live patch.

verdict.line: You lose levels 1–5 outright, and you win everything after 15 minutes.

brief.thesis: Renekton is one of the hardest early lane bullies in the game and Sett is one of the better late-game bruisers, so this lane is entirely about surviving levels 1–5. The saving grace is that Sett's W converts damage taken into grit while Renekton's all-in is front-loaded burst — his combo literally loads your gun. Most Setts lose this matchup by trying to trade first instead of letting him commit and W'ing back.

theirWindow.what: Empowered W stuns and deals bonus max-health damage. Do not be in range. Back off, farm under tower, and let him shove the wave.

yourWindow.what: He is one of the weakest champions in the game for those few seconds. Every trade and every all-in you take happens inside this window.

playing.title: Let him commit first
playing.detail: Eat the E-W, bank the grit, then W the true damage back into him. Land the centre of the cone, not the edge.

playing.title: Hold E until his dashes are gone
playing.detail: Facebreaker is your only hard CC and he will simply E away from it. Use it once both charges are spent, to guarantee the W.

playing.title: Ult him through his own R
playing.detail: Show Stopper scales off the target's bonus health and Dominus hands him a large chunk of it. His ultimate being up is a reason to commit, not to back off — as long as his Fury is spent.

playing.title: Suppression beats his escape
playing.detail: Once Show Stopper lands, his E cannot get him out of it. That is your kill window at 6.

playing.title: Lose the wave on purpose
playing.detail: He shoves with Q, so let him. Farm under tower and don't contest a wave you don't need. Every minute you deny him a kill moves the game toward the half you win.
